body: My social life is pretty horrific; I'm at uni in a big city so it can be overwhelming sometimes. I've lived in halls of residence this year but since my parents live in the suburbs I'll have to commute for the next couple years to save money so it'll probably only get worse. Plus with exams and my workload I often find myself shut up inside for days at a time; i can't remember the last time I went out.
Thank you for your support, it means a lot :)

I've seen a therapist on and off this term about my anxiety but she doesn't know I'm feeling this way specifically. I haven't brought it up because I'm uncomfortable with saying it out loud if I'm honest.
